text: I feel intrigued by my surroundings. The blending of glass, reflections, and vibrant digital displays fills me with a sense of anticipation—an invitation to learn and reflect. The invitation to research and development, the interplay of ideas on display, sparks my philosophical curiosity. The tilted angles remind me of the unsteady ground one sometimes feels when confronting new knowledge, yet that too is invigorating. I am on the threshold of discovery, pondering how spaces and ideas intersect to shape our understanding of the world.
